[[Bargh Shiraz F.C.|Bargh Shiraz]] | prevseason = [[2005–06 Iran Pro League|2005–06]] | nextseason = [[2007–08 Persian Gulf Cup|2007–08]] }} The '''2006–07 Persian Gulf Cup''' (also known as '''Iran Pro League''') was the 24th season of [[Persian Gulf Pro League|Iran's Football League]] and sixth season of [[Persian Gulf Pro League|Iran Pro League]] since its establishment in 2001. [[Esteghlal F.C.|Esteghlal]] were the [[2005–06 Iran Pro League|defending champions]]. The season featured 14 teams from the [[2005–06 Iran Pro League]] and two new teams promoted from the [[2005–06 Azadegan League]]: [[Sanat Mes Kerman F.C.|Mes Kerman]] as champions and [[Paykan F.C.|Paykan]] as runner-up. The league started on 9 September 2006 and ended on 28 May 2007.
